thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — sev2: embedder queue latency spike in us-west-2, paging oncall @Samir :rotating_light:
Samir: Oncall here. Acknowledge, jumping in. :thumbsup:
Maya-SRE: seeing p99 embed latency jump from ~1.2s -> ~15s, lots of retry traffic, 5xx spike on embedder instances
Samir: Mitigating now: ramping burst capacity on dedicated pool and routing a subset to fallback model-embed-lite. Running a soft throttle on large batches.
Claire-Product: Any customer impact? who to notify?
Maya-SRE: Impacted customers are those with large batch embeddings (>512). Two affected: Acme (heavy) and one small partner. Retries triggered by client-side SDKs.
Samir: Created remediation ticket RD-5234. Will capture immediate action items here and assign owners.
Samir: Immediate actions (tentative):
  - A1 reduce default max batch size in SDKs (owner: Maya, estimate: 2d)
  - A2 add routing fallback + rate-limit protection for large batches (owner: Mike, estimate: 1d)
  - A3 schedule postmortem + customer comms (owner: Claire, estimate: 0.5d)
Claire-Product: I'll draft a short interim note. Prefer to wait for postmortem for RCA. Propose postmortem Wed 10:00am PST.
Maya-SRE: Temporary mitigations applied, p95 back to ~300ms. Monitoring 30m window.
Acme-CS: Customer reports 'slow responses and retries'. Asked for ETA on fix.
Samir: @Acme-CS we'll send interim note in 1h. Claire to include any confirmed mitigations.
incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to sev3 — created remediation board RD-5234: https://rwd.in/board/RD-5234
Mike-Infra: I'll take A2. Plan: add modelVariant fallback and enforce server-side rate limit for batch size, add unit test and small canary. ETA 1d.
Maya-SRE: Quick sizing update: A1 is medium (3 dev-days) because defaults live in two SDK repos and need rollout; A2 small (1 dev-day); A3 tiny (4 hours).
Samir: Good catch. Triage decision: prioritize A2 and A3 in this sprint, schedule A1 for next sprint / Q2 reliability workstream if not urgent.
Claire-Product: Requesting A1 be tied to Q2 OKR (reduces unit-cost & customer retry risk).
Samir: Assigning owners in RD-5234: Maya (A1), Mike (A2), Claire (A3). Adding due dates and linking pre-read.
Maya-SRE: Postmortem scheduled Wed 10:00am PST. Pre-read uploaded: https://rwd.in/pm/RD-5234/pre-read — contains timeline, logs, and initial root-cause hypotheses.
Claire-Product: Shared comms draft in RD-5234 thread. Will send interim message to affected customers in ~30m and include escalation contacts.
Acme-CS: Thanks — please cc me on the outbound and include expected timeline for SDK default change.
Samir: :white_check_mark: closing the pager for now. Mitigations holding; continuing to monitor. Will update RD-5234 with any regression or new action items.
